subject: Demo follow-up: activation playbook + ownership matrix for Stonebridge Ops trial
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@stonebridgeops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Demo follow-up: activation playbook + ownership matrix for Stonebridge Ops trial

Hi Ethan —

Appreciate you and Lena taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight activation playbook so we can get the trial running with clear success signals. High-level asks below; detailed plan attached (stonebridge_trial_playbook_v1.pdf).

Goal: validate Redwood inference for low-latency document summarization and embedding workflows across your staging dataset.

Proposed 3-week trial (flexible):
- Week 0 (Prep): account access, network checklist, sample dataset upload (<= 10k docs)
- Week 1 (Validation): baseline metrics (latency, token cost per doc), functional checks, prompt variants
- Week 2 (Scale): concurrent load, KV/prefix caching verification, failure/fallback behavior

Success criteria (suggested):
- Mean token latency < 200ms for <512 tokens on dedicated instance profile
- Embedding cosine similarity improvement over baseline model per your eval set (delta > 6%)
- No PII leakage in logs; audit trail proofing with provided sample queries

Owners we recommend:
- Redwood: Ben Carter (SE) — technical setup, load testing
- Stonebridge: Lena Ortiz — dataset & access, Ethan — success sign-off

Next steps:
1) Confirm trial window and which dataset subset to use.
2) Procurement contact (procurement@stonebridgeops.com) — share any PO or redline timeline.
3) Ben will share a short network checklist and coordinate a 30-min kickoff early next week.

Attached: stonebridge_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (pooled checklist + timeline), network-security-snapshot.txt (sample of what we ask for).

If that looks good I’ll send Ben’s calendar and a tentative kickoff for Monday.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@stonebridgeops.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 18:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: activation playbook + ownership matrix for Stonebridge Ops trial

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick notes from our side after the demo:
- Lena confirms we can provision a staging S3 bucket and share IAM role details early next week.
- Procurement expects a short SOW/price note before approving the PO; can you share a one-page commercial summary?
- On success criteria: the latency target looks good but would you be able to show a 99p latency as well (our internal SLOs are tight)?

We’re good to aim for a kickoff on Monday; please propose a time. Also looping procurement for any contractual questions.

—Ethan

Stonebridge Ops

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: activation playbook + ownership matrix for Stonebridge Ops trial

Ethan —

Appreciate the quick reply. I attached a condensed activation checklist (stonebridge_trial_playbook_v1.pdf) — below are clarifications against your asks:

1) 99th pct latency: we’ll capture p50/p90/p99 during the Week 1 validation runs; recommend a short 30-min baseline run with 5k sample requests to capture distribution.

2) Commercial summary: Jordan — I created a one-page commercial snapshot and included it at the top of the playbook (page 2). If procurement needs a formal SOW we can generate one post-kickoff; timing typically 2–3 business days.

3) Network checklist & preflight: key items we need from your infra team (also in network-security-snapshot.txt):
   - Outbound HTTPS to api.redwood-inference.com on 443
   - Optional: allow egress to 35.203.12.0/22 for dedicated pool connectivity
   - IAM user with read-only access to the staging S3 prefix (or temporary signed URLs)

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Oct 4 — 10:00am ET (I’ll send an invite). Agenda: introductions, access handoff, baseline run plan, success metric sign-off.

If we get the PO timing, we can parallelize provisioning so the trial runs without delay.

Attachments: stonebridge_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (activation checklist + 1p commercial snapshot), network-security-snapshot.txt

Cheers,
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
